themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Outbreak Signal
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints spiked to 5 this week compared to a baseline of 0.8 per week (567% increase, z-score 6.43), suggesting a potential foodborne illness cluster in East Harlem requiring urgent public health investigation.
evidence: 5 food poisoning complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
567% increase with z-score of 6.43 (highest statistical significance in dataset)
Aligns with CB budget request for 'other programs to address public health issues'
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Health to identify which food establishments or events triggered the spike
Interview affected residents about symptoms, timeline, and suspected source to corroborate complaint data

themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints reached 10 this week versus a baseline of 3.6 per week (176% increase, z-score 3.42), representing an acute welfare crisis in the district requiring urgent investigation and possible law enforcement follow-up.
evidence: 10 animal abuse complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
176% increase with z-score of 3.42 (second-highest statistical significance)
Preceded by unleashed dog spike (4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 avg), suggesting broader animal welfare deterioration
reporting_angles: File FOIL request with NYPD and Animal Care and Control for details on complaints and enforcement actions taken
Partner with local animal rescue organizations to assess whether they're seeing increased intake from East Harlem

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Collection Failure
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints surged to 9 this week versus a baseline of 2.8 per week (227% increase, z-score 2.74), indicating a service disruption that compounds the district's long-standing graffiti and cleanliness concerns.
evidence: 9 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Synchronized with litter basket request spike (5 last week vs. 1.2 avg) and unsanitary condition complaints (718 over 90 days, top-5 volume)
Reflects CB's repeated budget request for 'Increase Graffiti Removal/Cleaning' (DSNY)
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY to determine if collection staffing shortages, route changes, or equipment issues caused THIS WEEK'S disruption
Interview residents about how missed pickups are affecting block conditions and vermin complaints

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints increased to 50 this week from a baseline of 27.5 per week (82% increase, z-score 2.63), reflecting broader quality-of-life deterioration across residential and commercial noise sources.
evidence: 50 noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 27.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (82% increase, z-score 2.63)
Residential noise is highest 311 complaint type overall (1,741 over 90 days)
Commercial noise also spiked 3 weeks ago (24 complaints vs. 13.4 avg)
Suggests dual residential and commercial noise sources rather than isolated incident
reporting_angles: Identify which specific blocks or venues are driving the spike via 311 complaint geolocation detail
Investigate whether construction, nightlife venues, or residential disturbances are primary culprits

themes_detail.label: Residential Heat/Hot Water Crisis Persists
themes_detail.summary: Heat and hot water complaints remain the second-highest volume issue (1,662 over 90 days) without a statistically significant spike this week, but represent a chronic housing quality failure requiring sustained investigation into landlord compliance and enforcement.
evidence: 1,662 heat/hot water complaints over 90 days (second-highest volume category)
No acute spike THIS WEEK, but chronic problem reflects systematic tenant vulnerability
Correlates with 514 plumbing complaints and 379 paint/plaster complaints, suggesting deteriorated building stock
CB repeatedly requests funding for 'Other capital budget request for DEP' and 'public health issues' programs
reporting_angles: Analyze 311 complaint patterns to identify repeat offender landlords and map enforcement against HPD violations
Document how prolonged heat/hot water failures affect vulnerable populations (elderly, children, immunocompromised)
